messages.text: Our pallet for PO 44821 was due Monday. Tracking has not updated in 3 days. Can you check where it is?
Accounting lost invoice INV-20931. Can you resend it to this address please?
We moved docks. Can shipment SH-7712 be delivered to 18 Harbor Way, Dock 4 instead? It has not left the depot yet as far as I can see.
Two cartons from today's delivery arrived crushed, contents look broken. I have photos. What do we do next?
Can we move tomorrow's 9am pickup to any time after 1pm? Our loading team is short-staffed in the morning.

subject: Locked out of portal after reset

messages.text: I reset my portal password but I still cannot log in, it says the account is locked.
Tried twice now, same result. I need to book a pickup today.
What is the expected delivery date for SH-8120 going to Denver? Our customer is asking.
INV-21044 has a fuel surcharge that was not in the quote we accepted. Why was it added?
Delivery was marked complete but we only received 11 of 12 boxes.
I counted twice with the driver's slip in hand. The slip says 12 but we signed for 11 by mistake.

subject: Add a viewer to our account

messages.text: Please add jordan.lee@example.com to our account as a viewer so they can see shipment status.

subject: Lab results not showing in portal

messages.text: I had blood work done last Tuesday and the portal still shows nothing under results.
Thanks for reaching out. Results appear once the clinician releases them. Let me check on this for you.
It has been 8 days. A friend said hers showed up in two days. Is something wrong with my account?
I need to move my Thursday 10:30 appointment with Dr. Alvarez. Work conflict came up.
Happy to help. Do you have a preferred day or time next week?
Any morning Tuesday or Wednesday. I tried the portal but the reschedule button is greyed out.
Also will I be charged since it is less than 48 hours away?
My latest statement shows the full amount of $342 as patient responsibility. My insurance should have covered most of it.
I am sorry for the confusion. Can you tell us which visit date the statement is for?
March 3rd, the follow-up visit. I gave the front desk my insurance card at check-in.
My card shows two $40 charges from Bluepeak on the same day for my copay.
We can look into that. Are both charges marked as posted on your card statement or is one pending?
Both say posted on my banking app. Dates are the 12th for both.
I would like one refunded please.
I want to manage my mother's appointments in the portal. She is 78 and not comfortable with computers.
We can set up proxy access. It needs a signed authorisation form from your mother.
Where do I get the form? And does she have to come in or can she sign at home?
My reminder text said my appointment is at 2pm but the portal says 11am. Which one is right?
Thanks for flagging. Which time zone is your phone set to, and did you recently travel?
I moved from Chicago to Denver last month. I did update my address in the portal.
I am switching to a new primary care doctor and need my records sent over.
We can do that with a signed release form. Do you know the receiving provider's fax or secure address?
They gave me a fax number, 555-0142. How long will it take? My first visit with them is in 12 days.
My telehealth visit starts in 10 minutes and the link just says Something went wrong.
Sorry about that. Please try refreshing and then a different browser.
Tried Chrome and Safari, same error on both. I am on my phone.
I really cannot miss this, it is a follow-up for my son.

subject: Bill lists a provider I never saw

messages.text: The bill for my April visit lists Dr. Weiss as the provider but I only saw Dr. Alvarez.
Thanks for pointing that out. We will check the visit record. Can you confirm the date of service?
April 18. I was there around 9am. I do not want to pay for a visit with someone I did not see.
My doctor said she sent a referral to a cardiologist last week but I see nothing under Referrals in the portal.
Referrals normally show within one business day. Let us check the status.
The cardiology office says they never received it, so now I am stuck. Who is supposed to follow up?
My order 55102 was supposed to arrive on the 3rd. It is the 11th. Where is it?
I am sorry for the delay. I see tracking says In Transit. Let me check with the carrier.
In Transit for a week is not an answer. I need to know where it is.
We have opened a trace with the carrier. It can take 3 to 5 business days.
You said that already on Monday. It has been five days since the trace and nothing.
I apologise. I can see the trace is still open. I will chase the carrier today.
This is the third time I am asking. Where is my order? It was a birthday gift and the birthday was on the 8th.
I understand how frustrating this is. Would you like a replacement or a refund?
I want to know why nobody told me earlier that it was lost. Is it lost or not? Just tell me honestly.
And if it is lost I want the replacement express and I do not want to pay shipping again.
I returned a jacket on the 2nd, order 54877. Your email said refund within 5 days. It's been 3 weeks.
Sorry about this. Can you confirm the refund method you expect and whether you got a refund confirmation email?
Back to my Visa. No confirmation email at all, just the return label email from the start.
Thanks. I can see the parcel was scanned at our warehouse on the 9th. Inspection is still pending.
Pending for 2 weeks? The return window is 30 days for me but apparently inspection has no window.
I will ask the warehouse to prioritise it.
You said that last time too. Please tell me a date. An actual date.
I do not have the exact date yet but I have flagged it.
Flagged is not a date. I will dispute this with my bank if I don't have the money by Friday.
To be clear: item 54877, jacket, $129.00, returned on the 2nd, scanned on the 9th. I want my $129 refunded.
Also I paid $9.95 for shipping, do I get that back or not?

subject: Wrong item sent, exchange keeps going wrong

messages.text: I ordered a large grey hoodie, order 55340. I got a medium black one.
I am sorry about the mix up. We will send the correct hoodie. Can you send a photo of the item and the label?
Photos attached. Medium, black. I ordered large, grey. Please just send the right one.
The replacement has been created, you will get tracking shortly.
Got the replacement today. It is a large black hoodie. Still not grey!
I apologise. It looks like grey was out of stock in large. We should have told you.
So why was my order accepted in the first place? I paid for grey large.
I do not want black. I want a refund for the hoodie, or grey in large if it comes back in stock.
And what do I do with two black hoodies now? I don't want to pay to send them back.

subject: Promo code not applied then charged twice

messages.text: I used code SPRING20 at checkout and the discount did not apply. Order 55419, total $84.50.
Sorry. Promo codes need to be entered before payment. Was the code entered on the payment page?
Yes, I entered it, it showed -$16.90 and then the final screen said $84.50. That is the undiscounted price.
Then my card was charged twice, $84.50 and $84.50. I only placed one order.
Let me check the payment records. Sometimes a pre-authorisation shows as a second charge.
Mine says posted, not pending. And I checked with my bank, it's real.
Thank you for checking. I will escalate to billing.
So to summarize: I want the discount of $16.90 and the duplicate $84.50 refunded. Please confirm both.
I received a $100 gift card from my sister. Balance in your portal says $37.
Sorry about that. Have you used the card on an order before?
No, never! I wanted to use it today and it says $37.00.
Could you send the card number and a screenshot of the balance page?
Sent both just now. The number ends in 4417. Balance shows $37.00 as I said.
My sister bought it on the 14th and the email said $100. I can forward it.
Please fix my balance, I have an order waiting in my cart.
I cancelled my Cobalt Box subscription on the 26th and I was charged $39.00 on the 1st.
Sorry about that. Let me look. Do you have a cancellation confirmation email?
I clicked cancel on the website and it said subscription ended. I did not get an email.
I see the cancellation was requested on the 26th. The renewal date was the 28th, which is within the 3 day notice window.
Nobody told me about a 3 day notice. That is not on the cancel button.
I understand. The terms are shown at sign-up.
I signed up two years ago! You cannot expect me to remember that.
Also now I am being sent another box, it shipped yesterday. Did you charge me for that too?
The box that shipped is the one for the charge on the 1st.
So I paid for a box I tried to cancel. I want a refund of the $39 and I will return the box unopened.
Please confirm in writing that the subscription is fully ended and I will not be billed again.
I am also considering a chargeback if this is not sorted today.

subject: Sofa arrived damaged, pickup keeps being missed

messages.text: My sofa, order 55021, arrived with a torn leg and a ripped seam. I sent photos on the 5th.
I am sorry. We have approved a replacement. We will arrange pickup of the damaged sofa.
Pickup was booked for the 9th between 8 and 12. Nobody came. I took a morning off work.
I apologise. I will rebook the pickup.
Rebooked for the 12th, 1 to 5. Again nobody came. I waited all afternoon.
I am very sorry. I will speak to the freight team.
This is the third thing that has gone wrong. Please do not rebook without calling me first.
I want a confirmed date and a phone number for the driver. I can only do Saturday morning.
Also, is the replacement sofa going to be delivered at the same time as the pickup? I don't want to have two sofas in my apartment.
Please answer all of that and don't just say sorry again.
I started a return for order 55200 four days ago. I never received a return label.
Sorry. Labels are emailed within one business day. Did you check your spam folder?
Yes. Spam, promotions, everything. Nothing. Is the email address on the order correct?
The order shows yuki.tanaka@example.com. Is that right?
Yes that's my email. So why no label?
I have resent the label just now. Please check again.
Nothing arrived. It has been 20 minutes. The return window ends on the 20th, I don't want to lose my refund.
Can you send a QR code or attach the label here? Whatever is fastest.

subject: Order split into 3 shipments, one lost

messages.text: My order 55288 was split into three parcels. Two arrived. The third, the lamp, has not.
Thanks for letting us know. Split orders have separate tracking numbers. Do you have the one for the lamp?
Tracking for the lamp says Delivery Exception since Tuesday. No other detail.
A Delivery Exception can mean an access problem or a wrong address. Is the delivery address correct?
Same address as the other two parcels which arrived fine. So no.
I will open a trace with the carrier for the lamp.
How long will a trace take? I need the lamp for an event on Saturday.
If it can't be here by Friday, I'd rather get a refund for the lamp and keep the rest.
Please tell me which one it will be, replacement or refund, so I can plan.

subject: Account locked, need address change on open order

messages.text: My account is locked and the reset email never comes. I need to change the address on order 55501.
Sorry. Accounts lock for 30 minutes after 5 failed attempts. Reset links expire after 60 minutes.
I know all of that, I already waited. I requested three reset emails and none arrived.
Could you check your spam folder? Only the newest reset link works.
I did check. Nothing. The order ships tomorrow so the address needs to change today. New address is 220 Pine Street, Apt 5B, Portland.
Can you just change it for me, I will verify however you need.
